src='''def transform(g):
 h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]; comps=[]; seen=set()
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   col=g[r][c]
   if col in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
   stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
   while stack:
    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
    for z in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
     if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and g[z[0]][z[1]]==col: seen.add(z); stack.append(z)
   comps.append((col,comp))
 for col,comp in sorted(comps,key=lambda a:max(x for y,x in a[1]),reverse=True):
  for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=0
  d=0
  while all(x+d+1<w and out[y][x+d+1]==0 for y,x in comp): d+=1
  for y,x in comp: out[y][x+d]=col
 return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(src)
exec(src)

print(ans)
